_avail.description: 10G HDMI, Ethernet, and USB Scaling Decoder - Singlemode

portsSource.from: Extron Streaming Products Engineering Drawings/Streaming - NAV Decod Eng.vssx
portsSource.label: NAV 10SD 501 SM

ports.label: HDMI Out
ports.notes: HDMI output from decoded NAV stream. Also carries CEC.

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced stereo. De-embedded from decoded HDMI / NAV audio stream. (5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw shared with IR. Pin configuration Tx/Rx/Gnd. (5-pole captive screw)

ports.label: IR Out
ports.notes: TTL-level IR (carrier 30-300 kHz) on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw shared with RS-232. Pin configuration S/Gnd.

ports.label: USB
ports.notes: USB 2.0 high-speed extension over the NAV link. Single physical USB-C port configurable as host or device mode.

ports.label: USB Config
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for Ethernet-over-USB device configuration.

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: External 12VDC PSU input (100-240VAC brick). Local power only — fiber NAV variants cannot be PoE-powered.
